title: Swin UNETR (SSL)
paper_title: Self-Supervised Pre-Training of Swin Transformers for 3D Medical Image Analysis
core_mech: 3D shifted-window hierarchy 与旋转、重建、对比联合自监督的 Swin UNETR。
core_mech_en: 3D shifted-window hierarchical Swin encoder coupled to a U-shaped CNN decoder and pretrained with multi-task 3D self-supervision.
input_desc: 未标注 3D CT 子体积；微调时输入带标签体数据
input_en: Unlabeled 3D CT sub-volumes for pretraining; labeled 3D volumes for fine-tuning
output_desc: 预训练层级编码器及下游 3D 分割
output_en: Pretrained hierarchical 3D Swin encoder and dense downstream volumetric segmentation

adapter.name: Swin UNETR (architecture)
adapter.mechanism: Hierarchical shifted-window transformer encoder and volumetric skip decoder.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
This lesson runs the segmentation architecture. The original SSL rotation/contrast/restoration pretraining and its checkpoint are NOT reproduced.
GroupNorm replaces InstanceNorm to support tiny spatial grids.
